info.desc: Wu-Tang Forever was the long-awaited follow-up to the Wu-Tang Clan's first album Enter the Wu-Tang (36 Chambers). It came following a string of successful solo projects from the clan's prominent members (Tical, Return to the 36 Chambers: The Dirty Version, Only Built 4 Cuban Linx..., Liquid Swords & Ironman). Forever was released on June 3, 1997 as a double album at the peak of the group's popularity and to high expectations. Despite limited radio /TV airplay and the lead single that famously clocked at nearly 6 minutes with no chorus, the album debuted at #1 in the U.S. with 650,000 .

lists.name: RYM Top — Hip Hop — Boom Bap

podcast.body: Released four or five years after their debut album, this album is considered by some to be even better than the first, and is recognized as one of the best albums in hip hop history and music overall. It was one of the best-selling hip hop albums in history and received critical acclaim as a masterpiece, earning some of the best ratings in rap history despite immense public expectation. Unlike their debut, this was a super-production with abundant resources, yet it successfully maintained the characteristic raw, underground essence of the Wu Tang Clan. While RZA continued to control the production, the album showcased a more cohesive and uniform group effort, with all members contributing significantly. The lyrics are considered the best the group ever wrote, deeply influenced by important Black liberation movements in the United States, such as the Black Panthers and FIPS, resulting in profound, committed, and explicit yet incredibly well-crafted verses. "es aún mejor que el primer disco y que está considerado, uno de los mejores iscos en el Hip Hop y uno de los mejores iscos en la historia de la música."

podcast.body: Released after the completion of RZA's initial five-year plan, this album marked the second major wave of Wu-Tang Clan's releases, though it coincided with a period where RZA's expansion plan became somewhat "magnified" and "massified," leading to some questionable artistic output. "Después de esos 5 años se saca el segundo álbum y es cuando viene a finales de los 90 ya 2000-2001 viene la segunda leada de grandes discos del Gutanclan."
